questions.question: Which language should the customer storefront use?
questions.rationale: The existing Next.js application is written in TypeScript.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Use the existing typed application codebase.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: The repository already uses Next.js 16 App Router and React 19.

options.label: Next.js App Router
options.description: Continue with the framework and routing structure already in this repository.

questions.question: What customer-facing frontend should be built? The current app already has a brand home page and account flows; its README lists catalogue, product details, search, cart, and checkout as unfinished. Specify the pages and interactions you want included.
questions.answer: Build the customer shopping experience: product catalogue, product details, search and filters, cart, and checkout, using the existing brand and account flows.
questions.rationale: The request says only ‘create front-end’, while the repository already contains a partial storefront and several possible unfinished shopping workflows.
questions.recommendedChoice: Build the customer shopping experience: product catalogue, product details, search and filters, cart, and checkout, using the existing brand and account flows.

questions.question: Which data and file storage should the project use?
questions.rationale: The existing backend uses Prisma with SQLite and serves product imagery; Blob Storage is the Azure option for persistent media storage.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: No persistent application data or associated storage is needed.

options.label: SQLite
options.description: Keep the current Prisma-backed SQLite database.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Use Azure Blob Storage for product images and other media.

questions.question: Will customers sign in to use account features such as orders and saved details?
questions.rationale: The existing app already provides customer registration, login, and account routes.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Customers sign in to access account features.

options.label: No
options.description: The storefront has no sign-in protected customer features.
